exposure: Type of RVOT intervention (none, single catheter-based, single surgical, multiple approach)
outcome: Tricuspid Lateral Annular Systolic Velocity (TV S')
cohort: The study included 447 patients aged 16 years or older with transposition of the great arteries and an arterial switch operation (TGA-ASO).
finding: TGA-ASO patients with previous RVOT interventions, particularly multiple approach interventions, demonstrated significantly lower exercise capacity (peak VO2) and RV-arterial coupling compared to those without RVOT interventions.
cross-section timing: Patients were assessed at a mean age of 25.0 years (IQR 21-29) in adulthood.
